title: Route Evidence and Analytics
summary: WLU records actual implementation choices and execution outcomes to provide a verified evidence stream for route statistics.
why: Separates the 'decision to act' from the 'evidence of what happened', enabling evidence-weighted route advice without giving the analytics layer any WLU authority.
invariants: Route Evidence: Non-entitling record of transitions, reasons (e.g. QUALITY_POLICY), and actual WLU spent.
Analytics: Read-only statistics over verified durable route evidence.
Sufficient Sample: Reports are marked 'insufficient' unless they meet a minimum sample threshold (default 30) to prevent over-reliance on small samples.
Advisory: Deterministic recommendation based on Wilson score intervals for success and over-expected rates; it is not admission authority.
evidence_note: Source: oorexx_work_load_units_v0.12/README.md:235-285. Line 240: 'This evidence remains non-entitling'. Line 260: 'Insufficient evidence is not hidden... sufficientSample is false until sampleCount >= minimumSamples.'
